proposal.reason: Primary change is in device communicator/window API semantics and compatibility handling: bounded API-version acceptance, new device API versioned structs/fields, GIN-only window flag behavior, safer properties copy sizing, and registration/cleanup/path-selection updates in dev_runtime and public device headers. Additional gin review is needed because there are substantive GIN-specific behavior changes beyond incidental wiring, including GIN connection/stride/backend consistency checks, context-count handling, single-segment GIN window-handle propagation, and new device-side waitSignal timeout overload implementations in GIN headers/funcs.
